description: Adds revenue growth rate and profit margin (usually EBITDA or free cash flow margin, both in percent). A score of 40 or more is the common rule of thumb for a healthy software company balancing growth and profitability. Use burn_multiple for capital efficiency instead. Guide: https://raziel.co/learn/evaluating-startup-traction-metrics

profit_margin_pct.description: Profit margin in percent, EBITDA or free cash flow margin (-15 = -15%).

revenue_growth_pct.description: Year-over-year revenue growth in percent (60 = 60%). Can be negative.

name: rule_of_40
title: Rule of 40
